title: Implement stats aggregation model
description: Create the internal stats report types and aggregation helpers for the approved wtp stats feature. Use Provider.ListTasks plus ListHandoffs; do not alter provider/storage interfaces. Support optional status-scoped task selection; overview metrics (total tasks, canonical status counts, model counts, dependency summary, retained handoffs); categorical attributes model/lane/priority/estimate/assignee with empty values represented as an unset bucket; comments metrics (tasks with comments and total records); dependencies metrics (tasks with direct dependencies and independent tasks). For filtered handoffs, include global records plus task-scoped records for selected tasks and preserve an all-status total when different. Ensure deterministic ordering (status/priority/estimate canonical, free text lexical). Keep the report shape suitable for human and JSON renderers.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Inspected repository guidance and downstream stats task contracts; implementing a renderer-neutral internal stats report with deterministic ordered buckets and filtered handoff accounting.
